annotations.shape: a Date stamped -0000 (no local time known) beside one zoned Received hop -- TimeEvent conflict case 3 of 5 (D2: -0000 is not +0000; the measured spike a05 shows parsedate_to_datetime returning a naive value for -0000)
annotations.phase_numbering: the design document's phases: 0 = the Phase 0 skeleton walker, 1 = the Phase 1 parser, 2 = routing and statuses, 3 = threading and time evidence -- every time.* fact here is phase 3
annotations.the_evidence: e_date carries when_utc unknown(no_utc_offset) and offset unknown(no_local_offset) with offset_origin absent -- the shape's rule that offset_origin=absent requires an unknown offset; ambiguity is timezone because that is what the fixture exercises; e_hop carries its stated zone
annotations.the_policies: header_date_claimed cannot place e_date at all (its UTC is unknown), so it orders what it can and reports e_date unplaced with a reason -- never as epoch and never repaired to +0000 (D2); received_chain_header_order places the single hop; owner_manifest is the labelled total-order override and is exactly where an owner's word can place what the evidence cannot
annotations.the_conflicts: the pair is unresolved because the two claims cannot be compared: one names a UTC instant and the other carries no UTC at all; time.evidence_conflicts is true and the pair list is non-empty
annotations.labels_are_typed: typed by a model from D2/D15 and the fixture's declared shape, never copied out of tests/support/timeline_ref.py or the library; labels_provenance is spec

value: the Date is stamped -0000, which states that no local time is known, so no UTC can be derived for it and it cannot be placed against the Received hop's zoned instant (D2: -0000 is not +0000, and a missing date is never repaired to one)
